paragraphs.content: The development of project named “The Grand” is to comprise of 3 towers that is The Grand Tower 1, The Grand Tower 2, The Grand Tower 3 respectively.
The Grand Tower 1 has been registered with the registration number P51900076793. The project details are available on the website www.maharerait.maharashtra.gov.in

The content on this website does not constitute an offer, an invitation to offer, a commitment, an obligation or a binding contract of any nature between the developer and the recipient or viewer.
All floor plans, drawings, amenities and specifications are subject to the approval of the respective authorities, including the Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai (MCGM/BMC).

The common areas and facilities proposed are subject to change. The developer reserves the right to make changes, alterations or revisions to the project, project layouts including the building layout, amenities, elevations, floor plans, specifications and dimensions, from time to time without prior notice, at the developer’s sole discretion.

The images on this website include artist’s impressions, computer-generated images and stock photography. They do not represent the actual or final delivery of the building, apartments, finishes, amenities or landscaping. Views shown are indicative only and are subject to change as per actual site conditions and future developments.

Customers and viewers are advised to independently verify all details, including approvals, RERA registration status, amenities and specifications, before making any purchase decision or acting in any manner.
The developer, its employees and its agents shall not be liable for any loss, damage or expense arising from the use of, or reliance on, information provided on this website.
All transactions in respect of this project shall be subject to the terms and conditions of the Agreement for Sale to be entered into between the promoter/developer and the purchaser.

The furniture, fixtures, home décor and interiors displayed are not provided with the flats. They are shown solely to help the viewer visualize the flat interiors and shall not be considered an offer, promise or commitment of any nature. All apartments will be sold bareshell as per provisions of the Agreement for Sale.
The landmarks indicated on the map (if any) maybe subject to change and to which the Developer/Promoter has no control.
The Grand Tower 1 is subject to mortgage created in favour of the Union Bank of India whose no objection would be obtained at the relevant time as required.

The Developer/Promoter reserves the rights to vary the dimensions in the floor plans. The furniture, fixtures, fittings that may be depicted in the floor plans and are not part of standard offering and are purely illustrative.
Any legal disputes arising from your use of this website will be governed by the laws of the State of Maharashtra and will be resolved by the courts at Mumbai.

This privacy policy (together with our terms and conditions and any other documents referred to on it) sets out the basis on which any data we collect from you, or that you provide to us, will be processed by us. Please read the following carefully to understand our views and practices regarding your data and how we will treat it. By visiting www.homesatthegrand.com ("Site") to which this privacy policy applies or otherwise, you are accepting and consenting to the practices described in this privacy policy.
WE MAY COLLECT AND PROCESS THE FOLLOWING DATA ABOUT YOU:

Information you give us : You may give us information about you by filling in forms on our sites, or by submitting your CV, or by corresponding with us by phone, e-mail or otherwise or, by you interacting with any of (sub-contractors (including estate agents, sales agents and our professional advisors) engaged on our behalf. This includes information you provide when arrange property viewings with us, request brochures from us, complete an enquiry form, provide your CV and when you report a problem with our sites. The information you give us may include your name, address, e-mail address, phone number and any other information relevant to your enquiry or request for information or services and you may choose to provide to us from time to time.

Information we collect about you : We may automatically collect: technical information, including the IP address, your login information, browser type and version, time zone setting, browser plug-in types and versions, operating system and platform; and information about your visit, including the full URL clickstream to, through and from our sites; materials you viewed or searched for; page response times, download errors, length of visits to certain pages, page interaction information, and methods used to browse away from the page.

Information we receive from other sources : We may receive information about you if you use our sites. We also work closely with third parties (including, for example, analytics providers, search information providers, credit reference agencies) and may receive information about you from them.
HOW WE USE COLLECTED DATA
We may collect and use your data including but not limited for the following purposes:
To provide you with the information and services that you request from us relating to the projects on our Site.
To provide you with information about our other project(s).
To provide you, or permit selected third parties to provide you, with information about our other project(s)
To administer our Site and for internal operations, including troubleshooting, data analysis, testing, research, statistical and survey purposes.
To improve our Site to ensure that content is presented in the most effective manner for you and for your computer.
For complying with legal obligations (if any).
For helping us respond to your customer service requests and support needs more efficiently.
We will only contact you by e-mail, SMS, telephone with information about our other project(s), only if you have consented to this.
DISCLOSURE OF YOUR INFORMATION
We may share your personal information with any staff member of the builder/promoter.

We may also share your information with selected third parties including, where applicable: (i) business partners, suppliers and sub-contractors (including, but not limited to, estate agents, sales agents and our professional advisors) (ii) advertisers and advertising networks that require the data to select and serve relevant adverts to you and others; (iii) analytics and search engine providers that assist us in the improvement and optimisation of our Sites; (iv) to third party/ies in the event we sell or buy any business or assets; (v) if we are under a duty to disclose or share your personal data in order to comply with any legal obligation, or in order to enforce or apply our terms of use and other agreements; or to protect the rights, property, or safety of builder/promoter, our customers, or others. This includes exchanging information with other companies and organisations for the purposes of fraud protection and credit risk reduction; and (vii) as otherwise disclosed or permitted by law.
We may share your non sales related information such as cookies, email address, phone number etc, to third parties.
WHERE WE STORE YOUR PERSONAL DATA

The data that we collect from you may be transferred, stored and processed by staff who work for us or for one of our suppliers or one of our group companies. By submitting your personal data, you agree to this transfer, storing or processing. We will take all steps reasonably necessary to ensure that your data is treated securely.
COOKIES

Our Site may use cookies to distinguish you from other users of our Site. This helps us to provide you with a good experience when you browse our Sites and also allows us to improve our Site. By continuing to browse our Site, you are agreeing to our use of cookies.
Please note that third parties may also use cookies, over which we have no control.
THIRD-PARTY WEBSITES

Our Site may contain links to third-party websites that are not owned or controlled by us. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or the content of such third-party websites. We are also not liable for any loss or damage that may occur to you on account of these third-party websites. We encourage the users to read the privacy policies of all such websites on visiting the same.
RETENTION AND DISPOSAL OF DATA

We keep the data we collect about you on our systems or with third parties for as long as it is required for the purposes set out in this privacy policy and for legal or regulatory reasons. By submitting your data, you agree to this transfer, storing or processing.
CHANGES TO OUR PRIVACY POLICY

We reserve the right to update or revise this privacy policy at any time without prior notice. Any changes will be effective immediately upon posting the updated privacy policy on our website. It is your responsibility to review this privacy policy periodically for any changes. Your continued use of the services following any changes to this privacy policy will be deemed to be your acceptance of those changes.

legacyHeading: Over 55 years of legacy in Mumbai's Real Estate.
legacyParas: Under the leadership of Samir N. Bhojwani, the firm’s direction has always been — prominent locations and lavish layouts, blending thoughtful design with superior amenities, trusted by the top business and media industry leaders.
The firm has landmark projects on the way – at Carter Road, Pali Hill and South Mumbai.
